built: Scope layer: choose_scope(request, llm=None) and rescope(current, message, llm=None) in one module. LLM stage 'vision_scope' (temperature 0, response_json, OPENROUTER_VISION_SCOPE_MODEL else the global model) with strict validation (paper_only bool, max_hops null or int 0..10, reason str; code fences tolerated). Any error, timeout (45 s thread guard) or invalid answer -> keyword fallback table; unsure -> DEFAULT (choose) / unchanged (rescope). llm=None with T2PW_OFFLINE_CURATOR truthy or a non-openrouter provider -> fallback only, client never imported at module import time. Rescope fallback uses view.more_detailed / less_detailed: DEFAULT->(False,2), PAPER_ONLY->DEFAULT, FULL->DEFAULT (less), DEFAULT->PAPER_ONLY (less). Negated depth words ('not the whole pathway') are stripped before matching.
